working_path.description: Execution cwd override, defaulting to the root CWR.toml directory. Relative paths resolve from that workspace root. CWR semantic validation requires an existing directory whose canonical path is the root or a descendant, including for absolute paths and symlinks. Does not change coworker artifact resolution or grant filesystem permissions.

message_mode.description: How CWR handles ordinary messages for this actor integration. actions_only returns the actor's currently visible action catalog without starting the adapter.

params.description: Adapter-defined parameters for this actor on the integration.
